def remove_comments\(source\):
    try:
        tokens = list\(tokenize.generate_tokens\(io.StringIO\(source\).readline\)\)
    except tokenize.TokenError:
        print\(''  WARNING: tokenize error, skipping''\)
        return source

    comment_tokens = [t for t in tokens if t.type == tokenize.COMMENT]
    if not comment_tokens:
        return source

    lines = source.splitlines\(True\)

    for token in reversed\(comment_tokens\):
        line_idx = token.start[0] - 1
        col_start = token.start[1]
        line = lines[line_idx]

        before_comment = line[:col_start]
        if before_comment.strip\(\) == '''':
            lines[line_idx] = None
        else:
            newline = ''''
            if line.endswith\(''\\r\\n''\):
                newline = ''\\r\\n''
            elif line.endswith\(''\\n''\):
                newline = ''\\n''
            lines[line_idx] = before_comment.rstrip\(\) + newline

    result_lines = [l for l in lines if l is not None]
    return ''''.join\(result_lines\)

        continue

    n_comments = sum\(1 for t in tokens if t.type == tokenize.COMMENT\)

        continue

    with open\(fpath, ''w'', encoding=''utf-8'', newline=''''\) as f:
        f.write\(new_source\)

    total_comments += n_comments
    files_modified += 1
    print\(f''  {fpath}: removed {n_comments} comments''\)
